plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a beginner-friendly off-camp boxing plan built around one focused full-body S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so later loading can stay practical and safe. Weeks 2-3 build strength and general power with crisp jumps, simple compound lifts, productive trunk work, and a short conditioning piece. Week 4 deloads by cutting volume while keeping movement quality high. The wider 12-week cycle stays off-camp: raise the force ceiling first, then build power harder, then express it with faster sport-relevant work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish a baseline and build general strength, simple power, trunk strength, and enough conditioning to support boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier main work while keeping weekly fatigue recoverable around skill training.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more toward fast strength, medicine-ball power, and sharp conditioning without forcing a fight-camp speed peak.
